svg.aria-label: How Starfold works. A table of measurements with no labels enters a search over the settings of UMAP and HDBSCAN, where each setting is scored against the same setting on a structureless copy of the table, and the setting with the largest gap is chosen. It gives a map and its groups, with a limit below which groups tend to merge. Refits on random subsets with new seeds then show what holds: how often pairs of stars stay together, how far each group recurs, and flags for what the evidence does not support. The marks are from a recorded run on APOGEE stars.
